observed.front: Apr2019 Street View (lot pano I2Dk, h164; ref 1118-nne-front01, camera fit h162.8 rms 0.5 px): greige lap siding, blue doors, grey walled courts with navy caps enclosing the east door of each pair (photo-mapped about 1-9.5 and 17.3-23.5 from the east end), paired downspouts at the centre party wall, wide upper windows.
observed.rear: Mar2025 (IQow, h28; ref 1118-ssw-rear02): pale grey lap, regular upper windows, tops of lower windows, A/C vents, continuous wood fence with a gate; yard doors are production_inference.

study_notes.eave: Wall top 7.651 = frozen flat base 2.351 + 5.3 m from dated photo proportions (production_inference); source height 6 m retained as identity only
study_notes.limits: Fences, vent pipes, post bands, carport-top finish (shared canopy uses the roof material), finish materials, site and decals parked for later levels. No recognition or stage acceptance claim.
